_comment: Template only. Real entries are generated per-node by tools/provision_node.py during Root of Trust provisioning (see smg_control_node/README.md) and must never be committed to version control: node_key and node_salt are the node's private authentication secrets (Stage 2.2.1 P_auth parameters). Copy this file to node_registry.json on the primary agent and let provisioning populate it, or paste generated entries in by hand.
